headline: Tencent Hunyuan releases open Hy-SimulMT for Chinese–English real-time simultaneous speech translation
summary: Tencent Hunyuan's official repository dates Hy-SimulMT's release to Oct 26, 2026 and links six model variants with inference and training tools for bidirectional real-time Chinese-English speech translation. The Simplified-Chinese README reports about 3 seconds StreamLAAL on the long-form RealSI comparison and favorable benchmark results, including a small comparison against professional interpreters. These outcome claims are first-party and unverified; StreamLAAL is not time to first speech output, and the human comparison uses selected high scores from six interpreters on 18 recordings. Tencent states that its publicly available inference-enabling code, parameters and weights are under Apache-2.0, while listed third-party components retain their own terms. The base variant’s model card lists 30B BF16 parameters and 60.9 GB across 17 shards; Tencent’s serving guide requires an NVIDIA GPU with enough memory. Peak VRAM, throughput and realized inference cost are unmeasured. The documented deployment also requires a configured TTS service for speech output and voice cloning.
